You have no Action token left. A Region in play says "Exhaust: gain 2 Materials" and carries no token. You have 2 Exhaust tokens left. You have a card marked Free action in hand.
What can you still do?
Nothing more
Exhaust abilities and Free actions don't use Action tokens.
Only exhaust the Region
That is possible, but so is the Free action.
Exhaust the Region and play the Free action
Exhausting costs an Exhaust token, and a Free action can be played even without an Action token.
The last card in your hand says: "Discard 1 card to gain 2 Population. You MAY acquire a Region."
Can you play it?
Yes, I gain 2 Population
The cost comes before the result, and you have no other card to discard.
What comes before "to" is a mandatory cost. With no other card to discard, the card is unplayable.
Yes, only to acquire the Region
The first sentence is mandatory and its cost unpayable: the whole card can't be played.
There is only one card left in the Unrest pile. A Market Tradition interests you; an Unrest is tucked under it.
How do you take it?
Acquire it
You take its Unrest, then the replacement card receives the last Unrest from the pile: immediate Collapse.
Innovate it
The Unrest goes back to the pile, which goes back up to two cards. The replacement card takes one: one is left, the game goes on.
It doesn't matter
The difference is huge: Acquiring empties the pile, Innovating refills it.
Cleanup. Your hand: 2 Unrest and 3 good cards you couldn't play. Your deck holds 1 card, your Nation deck 2.
What do you discard to evolve your nation as fast as possible?
With 5 cards in hand you don't draw: your deck doesn't cycle and no Nation card comes in.
My whole hand
You draw 5 cards, your deck runs out, and a Nation card joins your discard pile before the shuffle. That is the rulebook's advice.
Only the Unrest
That is legal and you also trigger the shuffle, but the Unrest will come back: you keep three cards at the price of a slower cycle.
Mid-turn, an effect makes you Draw 2 cards. Your deck is empty and your 5 Exhaust tokens are already placed on cards.
What happens?
I add a Nation card, then shuffle
You need an available Exhaust token to serve as a marker: you have none left.
I shuffle my discard pile without adding anything, then draw
The shuffle still happens, but with no Nation or Development card.
I don't draw
Only an "if possible" effect stops you. Here you must shuffle and draw.
You play Glory: you abandon three Regions. Two of them hold a Reserved card.
What happens to the Reserved cards?
They stay in play
A Reserved card always shares the fate of the card holding it.
They go to the discard pile with their Regions
So they will come back into your deck: think about it before playing Glory.
They return to my hand
That would be the case if the Regions were Recalled, not Abandoned.
Your opponent triggers the Countdown during their turn. You play after them and you are last in the round.
How many turns do you have left?
Just one
You first finish the current round, then an extra round follows.
Your turn this round, the Solstice, then one final full round with its Solstice.
The Countdown doesn't stop the game on the spot, unlike the Collapse.
Solstice. One of your cards says "Solstice: you MAY discard 1 card to gain 1 Population". You would also like to exhaust a Region.
What can you do?
No Exhaust ability during the Solstice.
Only the Solstice effect, if I want
The effect is optional thanks to "may". Exhaust abilities will wait for your next Activation order.
The Solstice effect is still available.
The Bot's turn. The revealed card matches two lines of its table. The first asks it to spend 3 Population to innovate; it only has one.
What do you do?
It spends its remaining Population
A cost is never half-paid.
Nothing: the card goes to the discard pile
First look for another applicable line.
I move to the next matching line
If nothing in the line can be resolved, go down to the next line that matches the card.
Solo game. There is one Unrest left in the pile. A Market card would earn you lots of points, with an Unrest under it.
Do you acquire it?
Yes, points first
The replacement card would take the last Unrest: Collapse, and in solo that is an automatic loss.
Against the Bot, a Collapse makes you lose whatever the Unrest split. Return some Unrest first, or Innovate.
Good choice.
Not the best choice.
